question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Support
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (1) i.e. **'Bolster'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Support' **means give assistance to, especially financially.**(सहायता देना**)

 
 
• **Example: **The best **support** for a camera is a tripod.
 
 
 
• The word **'Bolster' **means to support or strengthen.** (मजबूती/सहयता प्रदान करना)**
 
 
• **Example:** The fall in interest rates is starting to **bolster** confidence.
 
 
 
• As both the words **Support and Bolster **are similar in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
